{{Quote|Looks like Vader's personal droid bodyguard is still online. I have a bad feeling about this...|Luke Skywalker during the [[Battle of Vjun]]|<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>}}
'''ASP-38 Droids''', also known as '''Vader Droids''', were [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] security droids at [[Bast Castle]]. Equipped with a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] and 2 dual [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]], these droids were deadly to anyone who dared to infiltrate the Dark Lord's lair. After the former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] redemption and death at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], these droids continued to function.

Some time after the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|Declaration of the New Republic]], former [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[X1]] started to rebuild the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with himself as its leader. In order to learn the secrets of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], the self-proclaimed Sith Lord traveled to Vader's long lost sanctuary.

X1's brother [[X2]], now a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], was sent to Vjun to stop his brother. By the time he arrived, X1 had already left. X2 encountered these droids and a garrison of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Both were no match for the Jedi and were all slain. After retrieving [[Falon Grey]]'s [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[X1's holocron]], X2 escaped in a [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]], after his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] was destroyed by enemy fire.
